android.desc:
U.S. 270 is an electoral map viewer, editor, and historical resource. You can use it to explore possible election outcomes for the 2024 presidential race, create your own electoral map with different candidates, and share snapshots of your maps. Also, the historical data for all elections in U.S. history can be browsed along with informative links to the candidates and parties, and it will provide live updates of the 2024 results on election night as each state is called.  Users can also add their own predictions now to a Community Projection.
NOTE and Disclaimer:  The source of the historical election information is Wikipedia.  We are in no way associated with any government organization.  Election results are from the Associated Press.  Wikipedia electoral college data comes from the National Archives.  See https://www.archives.gov/electoral-college
